Writing v = dx/dt is correct. The missing piece is that the coefficient carries units through differentiation:

x(t) = (1 m/s³)t³
v(t) = (1 m/s³) × 3t².

Because t² has units s², the velocity has units (m/s³) × s² = m/s. The factor 3t² alone has units s²; it is the complete expression, including the coefficient, that has velocity units. For example, at t = 2 s, v = (1 m/s³) × 3 × (2 s)² = 12 m/s.
